Value proposition

FORMA teaches what a senior PM actually uses on site, in committee and in the room with the client.

Most AI and PM training is theoretical or generic. Not here. The line is designed to be funded via FUNDAE: the training cost is covered by the company’s training credits. Effective cost to the client: €0.

How FUNDAE works

0 €effective cost

FUNDAE manages the continuous-training credits of Spanish companies. Each company has an annual credit proportional to its payroll. Subsidized training covers 100% of the cost for small companies and 75–100% for medium and large ones.

  1. 01

    Registration as organizing entity or agreement with an accredited manager.

  2. 02

    Prior notice to FUNDAE 7 days in advance.

  3. 03

    Attendance records and certificate. Zirotti manages the full process or supports your own.

Frequently asked questions

Which AI and Project Management courses does Zirotti offer?

Three: Applied AI for project and construction management (16 h), Project Management for expansion teams (16 h) and Agile methodologies for executives (8 h, intensive format). All start from a real case and end with an applicable deliverable.

How much does the training cost if funded through FUNDAE?

The effective cost to the client is €0 when the training is funded with the company’s training credits. Subsidized training covers 100% of the cost for small companies and 75–100% for medium and large ones. Quotes are custom.

How many people can attend and how long is a course?

Groups are up to 12 participants (8 in the intensive executive course). Each course lasts 8 to 16 hours, in 8 h days or 4 h modules.

Who handles the FUNDAE paperwork?

Zirotti manages the full process or supports your own: registration as organizing entity or agreement with an accredited manager, prior notice to FUNDAE 7 days in advance, attendance records and certificate.

Shall we train your team this quarter?

Per closed session or quarterly pack (3–4 sessions with 10% discount). Typical cycle: 2–4 weeks.
